app.name: Wii Motion Synth
app.long_description:
A standalone Nintendo Wii homebrew application that turns your Wiimote into an interactive audio synthesizer with a real-time oscilloscope.
Controls: - Pitch (Tilt Up/Down): Adjusts Frequency - Roll (Twist L/R): Adjusts Volume - Hold B: Snap-to-Scale (Quantize) - Hold A: Square Wave (Default is Sine) - Hold 1: Sawtooth Wave - PLUS: Toggle Wiimote Speaker - MINUS: Toggle Oscilloscope / Stats UI - Nunchuk: Joystick controls LFO (Vibrato/Tremolo) - HOME: Exit
